about: The Workbench icons of the PuzzlePits drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own (packaging/linux/puzzle-pits.png, from its title screen). PuzzlePits-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, PuzzlePits.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's PuzzlePits.info. LEVELS.info is the levels drawer's.
